answer: Each identity requires a bonded registration whose proof-of-work hash forms a chain anchor in a public ledger. Forging N identities locks 500 tokens each and slashes 100% on detected double-spend, with disputes resolving over three epochs before withdrawal clears, avoiding any widening spiral. Copying credentials gains nothing: verification fee of 40 tokens per claim applies, and the bond serves as a single point of economic loss rather than a losing ripple.
